name: Yu So-ra
source:
A 3rd year in Yo-han high school. A model student who tops the school., thereby earning recognition and respect from others. Teachers have high expectations of her. Due to her pleasant character and looks, she is also considerably popular with the student body. Her hobby is reading and she manages the school library after school.

[From [url=http://visualnovel.wordpress.com/2008/06/28/lost-number-heroines/]Visualnovel's Weblog[/url]]
